name: cindra-dev-horizontal
title: Cindra — dev: horizontal (E-W) ribbon
author: Vuza
description: DEV/TEST-ONLY: flips the cindra-ribbon-orientation startup DEFAULT to "horizontal", so a run generates the E-W ribbon (fire at the top, ice at the bottom) without hand-editing mod settings. Exists so the integration suite can generate a real horizontal world (`npm run test:integration:horizontal`). Ships nothing; disable it to get the default vertical ribbon back.
